claim: DSO stays below 45 days at every quarter end; it was 38.4 days for 2026-Q1.

bundle.metric_definition: DSO = accounts_receivable balance / revenue x 90 days, where the balance is the 'accounts_receivable' row dated 2026-03-31 and revenue = sum(amount) for account 'revenue' within the period
bundle.notes: Export range: 2026-01-01 to 2026-03-31. General-ledger export from the ERP.
